handoffVersion.description: Transport envelope version; independent of Contract/Policy versions.

radar.description: Explicit radar namespace; no implicit inference.

runId.description: One collector execution UUID/ULID; stable across retries and all records in run.

observedAt.description: Per source item, UTC RFC3339 ending Z, generated once when parser first accepts the complete item; persisted in handoff and never reconstructed.

sourceUrl.description: Exact source item URL only when item URL exists; never query/API URL or unrelated reference.

recordId.description: Stable source-native item ID when present; otherwise SHA-256 of sourceKey plus exact item URL. Not Event/Observation identity.

facts.description: Allowlisted source facts only; preserve source-native values and exact item URL; no inferred score fields.

semantics.runId: One execution across collector; generated by scheduler invocation/collector before fetch, retained for retry.
semantics.recordId: Delivery idempotency key only; it never substitutes for Event eventKey or Observation observationId.
semantics.observedAt: Capture once per item at parser acceptance after complete response item decode and before filtering/LLM/Markdown. Same item retry replays exact stored timestamp.
semantics.source.sourceKey: Versioned static source-map key; source identity is explicit, never inferred from host alone.
semantics.source.sourceUrl: Exact source-level item evidence URL; omit/null and receipt-only when absent or noncompliant.
semantics.record.facts: Allowlisted normalized source facts, not Score Policy inputs. No final score/signal/action, score context, Event identity, or Observation identity.
semantics.versions: Explicit semver/build identifiers from collector and parser; do not infer from file mtime.

transportBatch.format: Atomic per-run JSON document with manifest plus records[]; each record is one envelope above.
transportBatch.hash: SHA-256 over RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) UTF-8 encoding of records array; no whitespace or key-order ambiguity.
transportBatch.canonicalization: RFC 8785 JCS; implementation must use a conforming library and fixed UTF-8 bytes.
